verdict.rationale: Railway's own marketing states the exact capability: custom dashboards with metrics from any service. The evidence is a single homepage line with no in-depth documentation or hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: detailed docs on dashboard building (widget types, metric sources, cross-service aggregation), independent or hands-on confirmation.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can build custom dashboards combining metrics from any service
